substantive_commits.summary: Integrate vegetation ecology and root-zone construction/validation into the formal foliage build path.
Add machine-readable vegetation formal-build integration contract.

problem_found: The formal 4K scene preparation rebuilt detailed trees and foliage but did not invoke the existing VegetationEcology and VegetationRootZoneInterface passes. A candidate could therefore reach later formal validation with sophisticated canopy optics while silently omitting contextual understory and the physically reconstructed tree-to-ground interface. This was a direct readiness risk for the Vegetation/Natural Complexity hard minimum and a secondary risk for geometry/contact and weathering causality.
changes: QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade.BuildFoliageOptics now validates the ecology contract, constructs VegetationEcologyDetail, reconstructs the root-zone interfaces, then runs the formal foliage validator.

QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene now requires both QualityBlockVegetationEcologyUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene and QualityBlockVegetationRootZoneInterfaceQA.ValidateOpenScene, making these passes mandatory for formal 4K scene validation.
Added vegetation_formal_build_integration_contract.json with execution order, construction/material reasoning, cause-based weathering rules, fail-closed conditions and render-only scoring policy.

implementation_readiness.reason: Formal integration is safer, but the missing seven points remain reserved for real Unity compile/runtime and evidence-path execution rather than source inspection.

expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Geometry & construction fidelity: medium improvement potential from explicit tree-ground interface
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Material/PBR physical plausibility: small improvement potential from required physical interface materials
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: small improvement potential from required contextual ground detail
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Weathering/context causality: medium improvement potential from ecology/root-zone causal metadata
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Vegetation/natural complexity: major improvement potential because ecology is no longer optional in the formal path
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: small evidence-readiness improvement; actual stability remains render-only

next_runtime_verification: Run a clean Unity 6000.3.0f1 formal PrepareAndValidateScene.
Confirm exactly six reconstructed root-zone interfaces: five paved and one grass context, with the contracted soil basins and edge/root transitions.
Failure injection: remove VegetationEcologyDetail after build and confirm QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene fails rather than recreating it.
Failure injection: remove or dimensionally corrupt one required root-zone reconstruction and confirm formal foliage validation fails.
Capture fresh reflection evidence, then actual 3840x2160 hero/frontal, oblique and applicable grazing-light views plus 100% tree-pit/root-flare and understory/ground-contact crops.

Run temporal camera evidence across tree LOD ranges and inspect floating vegetation, intersection, obvious repetition, aliasing/shimmer and visible LOD pop before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
next_blocker: No Unity Runner or actual benchmark render is available; compile/runtime, failure injection and 4K pixel evidence remain the gating work.
